__doc__: Allow-list for lint-icon-action.mjs (taxonomy C11). Entries: { testid?: substring, file?: substring, action?: key, reason }. A matching control is excused from the icon<->action check.

entries.reason: The trailing ChevronDown is the dropdown DISCLOSURE caret for the mobile settings-section picker (aria-haspopup=menu), not a settings-action icon. The heuristic misfires on the word 'settings' in the aria-label 'Select settings section'. Unchanged glyph from the prior react-icons IoIosArrowDown (visual parity).

The desktop Drawer's close control uses a directional back-chevron (ChevronLeft), preserving the prior react-icons IoIosArrowBack glyph (visual-parity mandate) and matching the web @ziee/shell Drawer close affordance. Whether it should standardize to X is a pre-existing design question predating this migration (both drawers used the back-chevron before); left as-is for visual parity, surfaced to the human for review.
